summary: Solidion Technology filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a routine board leadership update effective September 16, 2026. The company appointed independent director Mark N. Schwartz as Lead Independent Director and named CEO Jaymes Winters, already a director, as Chairman. No forced or abrupt CEO, CFO, or board departure occurred; no stake, price, premium, or transaction terms were disclosed. The filing also furnished an October 18, 2026 press release under Regulation FD. There is no deal, no advisor, and no risk-arb angle; this is a governance appointment rather than a special situation.
